subject: tr-info
title: (R)TR.INFO.------PROJ.DY.
description: Chart 2 of 2 on book p. 146 (UPB(II)-8). TR-INFO (trans-information) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; PROJ-DY (projectional dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits) and UPB (underlying philosophical basis). From RT-INT-TR: POL-P (political policies). From UPB: T-C-IMP (time continuum implications). From POL-P: LANG-DY (language dynamics) and SOC-RT-DY (social reality dynamics). From T-C-IMP: WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle). From SOC-RT-DY: POST (postulation).
